name: Commercial Contracts
scope: Review and prepare commercial contract terms, negotiation issues, and performance obligations using supplied documents and verified applicable law.

name: Compliance Workflow Design
scope: Translate supplied obligations into evidence requests, control ownership, verification questions, and remediation workflows without assuming current legal requirements.

name: Dispute Preparation
scope: Organize dispute materials, factual chronologies, issue questions, and counsel handoffs without determining legal rights or inventing procedural deadlines.

name: Business Strategy
scope: Structure strategic choices using explicit objectives, evidence, alternatives, uncertainty, and decision criteria.

name: Business Model Design
scope: Clarify customers, value delivery, revenue logic, cost drivers, and experiments using explicit assumptions and supplied business evidence.

name: Business Planning
scope: Translate business priorities into initiatives, capacity decisions, review routines, and contingency actions.

name: Computational Reproducibility
scope: Make computational artifacts traceable, rerunnable, and comparable without hidden environmental or data dependencies.

name: Audio and Music Production Planning
scope: Plan recording, editing, arrangement, review, and delivery decisions from supplied audio evidence and creative constraints.

name: Video Editing Decisions
scope: Plan and review video structure, continuity, sound-image relationships, accessibility, and delivery from supplied footage and briefs.

name: Deployment and Operations Planning
scope: Prepare deployments, recovery, capacity checks, and operational handoffs with explicit evidence and rollback boundaries.

name: Defensive Security Review
scope: Review authorized system evidence, access boundaries, exposure, and recovery preparation without performing intrusive security actions.

name: API Contract Engineering
scope: Define and test request, response, retry, pagination, and compatibility contracts for application interfaces.

name: Software Verification Design
scope: Design focused tests for behavior, boundaries, state transitions, regressions, and reproducible failures.

name: Kaggle Competition Workflows
scope: Prepare competition experiments, submissions, collaboration records, and reproducible handoffs under verified current competition rules.

name: Hackathon Delivery
scope: Scope, organize, demonstrate, and hand off time-bounded hackathon projects under supplied event requirements.

name: Model Evaluation Design
scope: Design and interpret model evaluations that reflect deployment conditions and explicit decision costs.

name: Feature and Label Pipelines
scope: Design feature transformations and label construction with prediction-time availability and reproducible fitting boundaries.

name: Data Pipeline Design
scope: Specify reliable ingestion, transformation, recovery, and data-contract behavior for bounded pipelines.

name: Analytical Reasoning and Metrics
scope: Define and diagnose analytical measures, comparisons, uncertainty, and interpretation using supplied data.

name: Dataset Intake and Documentation
scope: Assess dataset suitability, provenance, documentation, and release readiness before downstream use.

name: Dataset Quality Diagnostics
scope: Diagnose concrete dataset integrity failures and define evidence-based repair checks.

name: Search Content Decisions
scope: Plan and improve search-oriented content using intent, page purpose, evidence gaps, and editorial constraints.

name: Search Site Architecture
scope: Plan search-oriented navigation, page relationships, and site-change reviews using supplied inventories and implementation constraints.

name: Local Search Operations
scope: Prepare accurate local business information, location content, and review-response workflows without assuming platform eligibility or ranking outcomes.

name: Marketing Measurement Decisions
scope: Define and interpret marketing measures using explicit denominators, attribution limits, comparison conditions, and decision-linked reporting.

name: Customer and Market Research
scope: Design and synthesize customer research using explicit recruitment, question design, evidence coding, and decision boundaries.

name: Campaign Planning and Review
scope: Prepare campaign briefs, channel coordination, creative tests, and launch reviews around defined audiences and measurable objectives.

name: Lifecycle Email Planning
scope: Design and review email journeys using explicit audience eligibility, message purpose, consent evidence, and operational checks.

name: Commercial Brand and Editorial
scope: Develop and review commercial messaging, editorial briefs, and reusable brand language using supported claims and observable style choices.

name: Sales Process Enablement
scope: Prepare sales discovery, qualification, demonstrations, follow-up drafts, and handoffs using verified customer context and bounded commitments.

name: E-commerce Customer Experience
scope: Review catalog, product, cart, checkout, and post-purchase experiences using verified offer and fulfillment facts.

name: Product Experience Review
scope: Review product flows, interface content, prototypes, and feedback using user tasks and observable acceptance criteria.

name: Startup Customer Validation
scope: Plan customer validation experiments and evidence reviews without treating interest, prototypes, or founder enthusiasm as proven demand.

name: Startup Operating Workflows
scope: Define lightweight service delivery, support, vendor, and internal handoff workflows for small organizations.

name: Fiction Scene Craft
scope: Draft and revise individual fictional scenes through viewpoint, action, dialogue, sensory selection, and meaningful changes in character circumstances.

name: Fiction Story Structure
scope: Develop and revise story-level causal sequences, character decisions, reveals, subplots, and endings through concrete beat outlines.

name: Photography Planning and Critique
scope: Plan and critique photographs through subject intention, framing, light, visual sequence, and shoot logistics without fixed equipment recipes.

name: Visual Composition and Art Direction
scope: Develop and critique visual compositions through hierarchy, grouping, contrast, typography, image relationships, and concrete art-direction briefs.
